> Blog · Pipeliners · 2026-09-15

# Summary
Build folder for the fall seasonal post https://pipelinersusa.com/sewer-line-maintenance/ ("Fall Sewer Line Maintenance: How to Prevent Holiday Drain and Sewer Problems"). Files: build script, card HTML, `create_draft.php`, `add_cleanout.php`, an editor note asking for Jake's real cleanout photo (cleanout straight up beside a Phoenix Valley home), FAQ JSON-LD, live content and page snapshots, a redirects mu-plugin copy, and the SEO entry (title "Fall Sewer Line Maintenance Guide for Phoenix Valley Homes").

# Key facts
- **Status:** published Sep 14 as post 18123 (per the handoff); content backup meta `_pl_backup_content_20260915`.
- The Sep 18 merges redirected an old "Dos and Don'ts of Drain Care" draft to this post.
- The Oct 13 seasonal research treats this post as the owner of the holiday-grease angle, so new posts must link to it rather than repeat it.
